description.zh:
IPsec连接绑定的资源类型。默认值：**CEN**。

仅取值：**CEN**，表示查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息。
description.en:
The type of resource to which the IPsec-VPN connection is attached. Default value: **CEN**.

The value can only be **CEN**, which indicates that the system queries IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances.
The page number of the list. Default value: **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：**10**。取值范围：**1**~**50**。
description.en: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: **10**. Valid values: **1** to **50**.

description.zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh:
IPsec连接ID。

> 如果您不输入IPsec连接ID，系统默认查询当前地域下所有已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息。
description.en:
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

> If you do not specify the IPsec-VPN connection ID, the system queries information about all IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances in the current region.

title.zh: 查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的配置信息
title.en: Query configuration information of iPsec-VPN connections associated with transit router instances

example.unifiedCli: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-attachments --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --attach-type CEN --region cn-hangzhou
